purpose: Source provenance for retrospective global Project Athena research.

notes: Athena preflights large requests with the count endpoint and adaptively partitions them below the service query limit.
ComCat is the operational event source; source/catalog coverage differences must remain visible in research metadata.
Use as an independent large-event reference and completeness cross-check, not as an unqualified substitute for ComCat.
Historical global completeness varies by time and magnitude; Athena's first frozen 50-year cohort therefore uses M6.0+.
Retain original feature properties and source attribution when normalizing fault traces.
The source is global in scope but has documented geographic gaps; absence of a mapped nearby fault must never be interpreted as absence of active faulting.
